message: Manage AI providers and model availability across your instance and workspaces
bullet_points: Configure AI connections and models in **Admin → AI providers**, or per workspace in **Settings → AI providers**, and choose which features may use each model.
Upgrading imports existing environment and workspace AI settings automatically; no commands are needed. A workspace that had its own settings keeps using only its own models.
Legacy Baserow provider and model environment variables are deprecated. See the breaking change entry for what changes after the import.
